name: Que Tra Bong
summary: Quế Trà Bồng is thick, dark cinnamon bark from Trà Bồng, high in oil, warmly fragrant, and mildly hot. It comes as quills, powder, chips, tea, and oil, a spice to cook with or carry home.
culture: Vietnam Airlines says the bark holds a geographical indication and grows on more than 1,700 hectares in Trà Bồng.
taste: Vietnam Airlines says the bark is thick and dark, high in oil, warmly fragrant, and mildly hot. The provincial introduction says thơm nồng.
howToEat: Vietnam Airlines lists quills, powder, chips, cinnamon tea, and craft objects, and calls it a spice, a medicinal bark, and a gift.
where: Trà Bồng, in the hills west of the city.
priceBand: 55,000 VND a kilogram for dried bark, 150,000 VND for 500 g of powder, and 200,000 VND for 10 ml of oil (Vietnam Airlines).
seoTitle: Que Tra Bong — Tra Bong cinnamon
seoDescription: Quế Trà Bồng, thick and warmly fragrant cinnamon bark from Trà Bồng, sold as quills, powder, and oil.
